data.raw_text:
⚠️TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Avalon East RCMP advises all motorists that a passenger bus is currently blocking the Avondale Access Road (Route 63) in both directions near the racetrack. The road will be closed in this area until further notice.

The weather and road conditions remain unpredictable across Eastern Newfoundland, and all drivers are asked to use caution and slow down. Remember to clear all snow from your vehicle, turn on your headlights and ensure you leave lots of time and space between vehicles.
